import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**What I built**

- **Create route** (`src/native/highlights_ref/create/podcast_route.rs`, called right after the arXiv branch in `create.rs`):
  - **Defaults:** the ref type defaults to `podcasts`, and the stem comes from the title. A title with no ASCII letters falls back to `spotify_episode_<lowercased id>`.
  - **Metadata:** the author is the show, and `published` is the local release date. `-T`, `-A`, `-p`, `-N` and `-t` each override their field.
  - **Recapture and store:** reread and `-f overwrite` behave as on the arXiv route. The source view is saved, so `bob ref links` works.
  - **Failure handling:** a metadata failure writes nothing. A missing cover or a metadata fallback prints exactly one `warning:` line each.
- **Help and docs:** the create help gains the Spotify target line and an example, and both type lists now mention `podcasts`. `docs/highlights-create.md` has a new `## Spotify episodes` section and updated tables.
- **Tests:** 8 new CLI tests in `tests/cli/highlights/podcast_create.rs`, plus unit tests.

**Two fixes outside this phase's own files**
- **Non-ASCII title crash:** `title_stem` crashed on any title ending in a non-ASCII character. That could have crashed web-article captures too, not just podcasts.
- **Text escaping the notes column:** in the live PDF, a trailing "Get full access…" line printed outside the notes column. Spotify sends that text outside any paragraph, so `notes.rs` now wraps such text in one. I re-checked the rendered page after the fix.

**Live test result:** the PDF has the title once, "November 18, 2026", "1 h 26 min", 16 linked chapters, the full notes and a sponsors card. "See all episodes" is gone. I looked at both pages rendered as images and they match the visual spec.
